start: Gym tab row 'Message your gym' ('Ask a question, share feedback or make a complaint'), joined gym with 0069 and 0096 live, online

user_sees: Page titled 'Message your gym'
'What is it about?' with chips 'Question', 'Feedback', 'Complaint'
'Who should read it?' with 'Gym owner' and the trainers, own trainer as '<name> (your trainer)' first
must_not: A trainer chip for Feedback or Complaint
Another gym's trainers

steps.action: Pick 'Question' and the own trainer, type a question
user_sees: '<trainer> reads your question and gets a notification. The owner of <gym> can read it too.'
'<n> of 1000 letters'
must_not: More than 1000 letters taken

user_sees: 'Sent. When your gym replies, you will see it below.'
Under 'Your messages': 'Question · To: <trainer> · <when>' and 'Not seen by your gym yet. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: Two threads from one send
The typed text kept in the box after a good send

steps.action: The trainer replies; open the page again
user_sees: '<name> from your gym · <when>' with a 'New' tag; the Gym tab row says 'Your gym replied. Tap to read it.' and the tab bar badge counts it
must_not: The red count staying after the reply was read
The reply shown under another thread

start: A gym reply's notification on the lock screen (kind gym_reply)

user_sees: 'Message your gym' page opens on 'The gym' with the reply shown
must_not: The app opening on the Workout tab instead
Another member's thread

start: Message your gym page, kind 'Complaint' (another kind)

user_sees: 'Only the owner of <gym> reads your complaint. The front desk and trainers do not see it.'
Placeholder 'For example: The AC in the cardio room is not working.'
must_not: A trainer chip offered
'Send without my name' offered for a complaint

user_sees: 'The owner and front desk at <gym> read your complaint. Your trainers do not see it.'
must_not: The line still saying only the owner reads it

user_sees: 'Complaint · To: Gym admin · <when>' in 'Your messages'
must_not: The complaint reaching a trainer

start: Message your gym page, nothing typed / only spaces

steps.action: Look at 'Send message' with an empty box
user_sees: The button is greyed out
must_not: A thread with empty text

user_sees: The button stays greyed out; a forced send shows 'Please type your message first.'
must_not: A blank message sent to the gym

start: Message your gym page, server refusals

steps.action: Send many messages in one day until the server says TOO_MANY
user_sees: 'You have sent a lot of messages today. Please try again tomorrow.'
must_not: 'Sent.' shown for a refused message

user_sees: 'Messages to your gym are paused for now. Please ask at the front desk.'
must_not: The typed text cleared on a refusal

user_sees: 'Could not send. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: A success message
The text lost

user_sees: 'Messaging your gym is not ready yet. Please check again later.'
must_not: A send box that cannot send

start: A thread the gym marked done

user_sees: 'Your gym marked this as done. Write back if you need more help.'
'Write back' button
must_not: No way to reply

user_sees: 'Sent.'; the thread is open again with the new line under 'You · <when>'
must_not: The thread staying marked done after the member wrote back

steps.action: Keep writing back until the thread holds 50 lines
user_sees: 'This conversation is full. Please send a new message instead.'
must_not: A silent failure

start: Feedback sent with 'Send without my name'

steps.action: Pick 'Feedback', switch on 'Send without my name'
user_sees: 'Your gym can still reply here, but it will not see who sent it.'
'Only the owner and front desk at <gym> read your feedback. Your trainers do not see it.' (or the 'Gym owner' / 'Gym admin' line)
must_not: The switch offered for Question or Complaint

user_sees: 'Feedback · ... · Sent without your name'
must_not: The member's name or number shown to the gym
A trainer seeing the feedback
The thread kept beyond 180 days after the last message
